timing: Recorded after metadata-only feasibility, before follow-up classifier predictions or paired change results
role: New prespecified extension within an already studied ADNI participant cohort; not independent participant confirmation or external validation
purpose: Test whether source-fitted four-feature anatomical behavior reconstruction captures natural within-person classifier-output variation beyond scalar reference information and a fixed four-feature anatomical control
population: All 402 pairs from the frozen feasibility manifest, including both participants in sparse ADNI4 Siemens; no outcome-based or domain-based exclusions
classifier: Existing 290 source seed checkpoints and original calibration/ROI preprocessing; apply only each pair's corresponding outer-domain models; average the same five seed probabilities before logit, clipped to [0.0001,0.9999] as in the original pipeline
target: Observed follow-up minus anchor calibrated model logit, not a diagnosis or a clinical progression outcome

predictors.AD4: Original source-domain StandardScaler plus Ridge(alpha=1) from four severity features to model logit; subtract the two visit predictions. Same acquisition indicators at both visits, so original additive acquisition component cancels.
predictors.REF1: StandardScaler plus Ridge(alpha=1) from the original transparent reference's clipped logit to model logit, fitted on the same source rows as AD4; subtract visit predictions.
predictors.CONTROL4: StandardScaler plus Ridge(alpha=1) from fixed caudate, pallidum, pericalcarine and precentral features to model logit, using original source-domain preprocessing and identical source rows; subtract visit predictions.

fit_scope: For each configuration/evaluated domain, only original source outer predictions from other domains. No confirmation/follow-up fitting, hyperparameter tuning, new ROI search, or outcome-based selection.
primary_metric: Absolute error in predicted logit change. First average errors over each participant's available configurations, then average equally over participants.
uncertainty: 2000 paired participant bootstrap resamples, seed 20261010, retaining all configurations per selected participant. Fixed predictions, no refitting; nominal percentile 95% intervals.
bounded_positive_criterion: Both contrast intervals have lower bound above zero, both point relative MAE reductions are at least 10%, and AD4 has smaller MAE than each comparator in at least 7 of 9 configurations. The 10% threshold is a prespecified practical signal threshold, not a clinical minimum benefit.
secondary_reporting: All four MAEs, observed change scale, signed bias, configuration and domain results including sparse domains; no diagnostic accuracy, clinical or causal inference
validation: Original-anchor model probabilities reproduce cached confirmation probabilities within absolute 1e-6
Every scan/config has exactly five frozen seeds
Pair members share source-domain models and metadata
Same subject/scan/config keys for all methods
Independent recomputation of paired aggregate losses and intervals
failure_rule: If any co-primary criterion fails, retain the failure; do not change pair windows, cohorts, comparators, thresholds or selection rules to seek a passing result
interpretation: Passing supports natural within-person behavioral reconstruction relative to specified comparators in this dataset. It does not establish local intervention fidelity, human report utility, clinical progression, disease causality, or attainment of the overall scientific-strengthening goal.
